# ShopMarginLab
> Free 2026 E-Commerce Fee, ROAS, POD & Tax Calculators. Free browser-based 2026 US marketplace fee calculators, multi-channel profit comparison, and unlocked Excel seller workbooks.

## Interactive Multi-Channel Comparison
- [7-Channel Live Fee Showdown](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/compare/): Compare net profit across Shopify, TikTok Shop US, Etsy, Mercari, Whatnot, eBay, and Poshmark simultaneously.

- [2026 Etsy Fee & Profit Margin Calculator (With Offsite Ads)](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/etsy-fee-calculator/): Calculate exact 2026 Etsy seller fees ($0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 Etsy Payments, and 12%–15% Offsite Ads), net profit, and break-even price.

- [2026 TikTok Shop US Seller Fee & Creator Commission Calculator](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/): Calculate true TikTok Shop US margins after the 6% referral fee (or 3% new seller promo), 10%–25% creator affiliate cuts, FBT shipping, and GMV Max ads.
- [Print-on-Demand (POD) Pricing & Profit Margin Calculator (2026)](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/print-on-demand-profit-calculator/): Calculate real Print-on-Demand profit margins on Printify & Printful across Etsy or Shopify—including Printify Premium 20% blank discounts and sale pricing.
- [Break-Even ROAS & Target CPA Calculator for E-Commerce Ads](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/roas-break-even-calculator/): Calculate your exact Break-Even Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), maximum allowable CPA, and net profit at 2x, 3x, and 4x ROAS for Meta, Google, and TikTok Ads.
- [Landed COGS, Wholesale & Retail Markup Margin Calculator](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/wholesale-retail-markup-calculator/): Calculate landed unit cost (manufacturing + freight + import tariffs + packaging) and set profitable wholesale (50% keystone) and DTC retail prices.
- [2026 Amazon FBA Fee, PPC ACoS & Net Profit Margin Calculator](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/amazon-fba-fee-calculator/): Calculate exact 2026 Amazon US FBA profit margins including referral fees (8%–17%), FBA pick-and-pack fees, monthly storage, PPC ACoS, and ROI %.
- [2026 eBay US Seller Fee & Profit Margin Calculator (With Promoted Listings)](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/ebay-fee-calculator/): Calculate exact 2026 eBay US final value fees (13.6% + $0.40 per order), eBay Store discounts, Promoted Listings ad fees, and true net profit.
- [2026 Shopify Plan & Payment Fee Calculator (Basic vs. Grow vs. Advanced)](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/shopify-fee-calculator/): Calculate exact 2026 Shopify Payments fees and compare Basic ($39/mo), Grow ($105/mo), and Advanced ($399/mo) to find the cheapest plan for your monthly revenue.
- [2026 Etsy Offsite Ads Calculator — Exact Price Buffer Formula](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/etsy-offsite-ads-calculator/): Protect your Etsy shop from 12% mandatory or 15% Offsite Ads fees. Calculate your exact worst-case profit, blended margin, and safe price adjustment.
- [2026 Printify vs. Printful Profit Margin & Monthly Savings Calculator](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/printful-vs-printify-calculator/): Compare exact per-shirt and annual profit between Printify Standard, Printify Premium ($29/mo), and Printful across your monthly Print-on-Demand order volume.

- [2026 Shopify Net Profit Margin & Order Economics Calculator](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/shopify-profit-margin-calculator/): Calculate true Shopify per-order net profit after landed COGS, shipping & packaging, Shopify Payments fees (2.9% + $0.30), Meta/TikTok CPA, and return rate.
- [2026 Etsy Digital Product Profit & Fee Calculator (PDF, Canva, SVG)](https://shopmarginlab.pages.dev/etsy-digital-product-profit-calculator/): Calculate exact 2026 Etsy fees and net profit for digital downloads (printables, Canva templates, SVGs, spreadsheets) — $0 shipping, $0 COGS, 6.5% + 3% + $0.45.
